parsed.note_claim: Some telcos blocked access to Discord in the Philippines while others did not, and Discord is complying with CICC demands.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Globe and DITO were still blocking Discord at the CICC's afternoon briefing, and no network has said since that it has lifted the block. Smart and Converge never applied it.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms that some telcos blocked Discord while others did not, and also describes Discord committing to CICC demands including a Philippine presence, substantiating the note's claims.
